title: US$5 trillion economy by 2025
analysis: The BJP manifesto specifies US$5 trillion by 2025. The World Bank WDI calendar-year 2025 nominal GDP series reports US$3.956 trillion. This measures the target, not whether the economy grew in real terms.
caveat: Exact manifesto target; evaluate nominal USD by deadline

title: US$10 trillion economy by 2032
analysis: The documented US$10 trillion by 2032 deadline is in the future. The present data do not warrant an achievement verdict.

title: World third largest economy by 2030
analysis: The manifesto names third-largest nominal economy by 2030; deadline has not arrived. Confirm the precise ranking definition before grading.
caveat: Future; rank by nominal USD unless original defines differently

title: ₹100 lakh crore capital investment in infrastructure by 2024
analysis: The Rs100 lakh crore infrastructure commitment needs a consistent definition of “capital investment” and verification against the original time period. No verdict published yet.
caveat: Verify programme definition and government vs all-sector sums

title: Top 50 Ease of Doing Business ranking
analysis: The World Bank discontinued Doing Business in 2021. The original ranking is unavailable for a 2026 on-the-same-scale comparison; do not invent a replacement rank.
caveat: Series discontinued in 2021; cannot assess after that with same metric

title: Continue simplifying GST

caveat: Process commitment, define operational criteria before assessment
